title: Add VIVO X300 PRO to Products catalog dataset

requirements.summary: Add a new local product dataset entry for "VIVO X300 PRO" priced at "54999" so it appears and is searchable/filterable in the Products catalog.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/data/products.ts` includes a new `Product` with `name: 'VIVO X300 PRO'` and `price: '54999'`.
The new product has a unique numeric `id` not used by existing items.
The new product renders on the Products page grid and can be found via the search input by typing "VIVO" or "X300".
No backend changes are required for the product to appear.

file_operations.description: Append a new `Product` object to the exported `products` array with a unique numeric `id` (next available after existing items), `name: 'VIVO X300 PRO'`, a reasonable `category` consistent with catalog filtering, a short `description`, and `price: '54999'` (as a string) so it is included in the Products page search/filter results.
